json.evidence: Photos show the exterior of a commercial/utility building with closed steel doors labeled as transformer rooms (e.g., 'F 51.2 Traforaum') with high-voltage warning signs, an outdoor louvered grey electrical kiosk/switchgear cabinet (closed), and temporary orange cables and a white conduit on scaffolding entering an open room. Through the open door only a radiator/grate and bare walls are visible. No load center, panelboard, main breaker, or disconnect is visible in any open, close-up, or readable-label view.
json.notes: The equipment appears to be utility/medium-voltage transformer rooms and a switchgear kiosk, not residential main panels. None of the enclosures are open, so neither the number of true service mains nor any feed relationship can be determined. Multiple adjacent closed enclosures do not qualify as true multiple main panels.
